drafts.text:
HOOK
The Federal Reserve is about to reveal what really happened behind closed doors.
[ON SCREEN: Fed building graphic with "FOMC Minutes"]

WHAT IT IS
The US FOMC Minutes drop today at 14:00 ET, giving traders a detailed look inside the central bank's latest policy debate.
[ON SCREEN: Text "FOMC Minutes: 14:00 ET"]

WHY IT MATTERS
This release can spark sharp swings across the US Dollar Index, EUR/USD, Gold, and the S&P 500. Active traders will comb through the text to see how divided policymakers were on interest rate cuts and economic growth.
[ON SCREEN: Tickers: DXY, EUR/USD, XAU/USD, S&P 500]

WHAT TO WATCH
If the tone leans hawkish, showing persistent inflation worries, the dollar could rally while stocks and Gold pull back. On the other hand, any focus on labor market softness could weaken the dollar and lift equities.
[ON SCREEN: Graphic comparing hawkish vs dovish market reactions]

CLOSE
Catch the full breakdown on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo and website URL]

drafts.text:
HOOK
Japan is about to report preliminary growth figures, and the yen is on alert.
[ON SCREEN: USD/JPY chart]
WHAT IT IS
Preliminary Q3 GDP data drops at 18:50 ET. Consensus expects growth to slow to 0.1%, down from 0.4% in the prior quarter.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 0.1% vs Previous 0.4%]
WHY IT MATTERS
This print is crucial for both USD/JPY and the Nikkei 225. It shows whether domestic demand is holding up or if momentum is fading fast.
[ON SCREEN: USD/JPY and Nikkei 225 tickers]
WHAT TO WATCH
Traders will watch the divergence closely. A figure above forecast could support the yen if it suggests underlying resilience. If the number prints below expectations, USD/JPY could see upside pressure as growth concerns weigh, while the Nikkei might react to the shifting currency dynamics.
[ON SCREEN: Bullish vs Bearish reaction scenarios]
